set.body: Slice of Ledger S2 (bd-01M3FA6GY2YX7098MRYVKSR9ZK): CsvTokenCursor, the LedgerSource/TextHash/TextOrder/InventorySort cursors, LedgerScalarPreflight, the Preflight/Description/Evidence/Input cursors, and LedgerExecutionLimits/Evidence. Resource and limit types are private[io]. Unsupported, CsvTokenError and LedgerDescriptionError messages name their operands; preflight has its own error type; fields are stored as offsets, not Vector[Char]; retention is documented as a cumulative cap. Lands with S2.3 (no caller before it).
set.title: Ledger S2.2: ledger cursor foundations, API-clean
